brief:
Some pro-Palestine activists have distanced themselves from New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, despite his record as arguably the city's most pro-Palestinian elected official, Middle East Eye reported. The rift reflects disagreements within the movement over tactics and approach to advancing Palestinian causes.

Mamdani, who has championed pro-Palestinian positions throughout his tenure, faces criticism from segments of the activist community who question his methods or priorities. The divisions reveal friction between elected officials working within political systems and grassroots movements pursuing more confrontational advocacy.
dek: Why some pro-Palestine activists have turned their backs on Mamdani New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani is arguably the most pro-Palestinian mayor in New York City's history.
title: Pro-Palestine activists split with New York Mayor Mamdani over strategy
